name: card-stack
title: Card Stack
description: A small pile of dark quote cards with the front one at full size and the rest fanned behind, each slightly smaller and higher. On a timer the top card slips to the back so the deck keeps cycling.
use: Customer quotes should rotate in a compact spot without arrows or dots taking space.
avoid: Readers must control the pace, or quotes are long enough to need more than a few seconds.
a11y: The deck cycles on a timer with no pause or previous/next control and no reduced-motion check, so a quote can vanish mid-read. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A stack of dark rounded cards on black with one in front and the edges of two or three fanned behind it. The front card holds a short quote with phrases picked out in emerald green, and a name and role at the bottom.
behaves: Every two and a half seconds the front card drops to the back of the pile and the next rises to the front, growing back to full size, so the deck cycles through its quotes forever. There is no pause, drag or arrow.
customise: items supplies each card's content, name and designation; offset, scaleFactor and duration tune the fan and the timing. Card size and colours are fixed in the classes.
weight: light: A handful of stacked cards reordered on one interval.
demo: Quotes from Manu Arora, Elon Musk, Tyler Durden and Priya Raman with roles and emerald highlighted phrases.
issues: There is no pause or navigation, so a card flips every 2.6 seconds even while being read.
Frames 2 and 3 show two cards' text overlapping for a moment mid-flip.
polishWhy: A tidy fanned deck with a smooth cycle, but the mid-flip overlap and missing controls hold it back.
